agent.customerAnalysis.name: Search Cluster Landscape
agent.customerAnalysis.desc: Groups co-searched keyword clusters by search purpose and analyses hub keywords and exploration flows in one pass.
customerAnalysis.dash.personaEvidenceTit: Keywords That Best Represent This Cluster
customerAnalysis.dash.volTooltipHint: Click to view the keyword list
customerAnalysis.purpose.body: This report analyses the search clusters — groups of keywords that get searched together — formed around '{category}', to reveal the landscape of search purposes and the exploration flows present in the {market} market. Keyword clusters were collected from the ListeningMind ClusterFinder co-search graph, and purpose clusters and hub keywords were derived from search volume.
customerAnalysis.purpose.bodyNoMarket: This report analyses the search clusters — groups of keywords that get searched together — formed around '{category}', to reveal what landscape of search purposes and exploration flows exists. Keyword clusters were collected from the ListeningMind ClusterFinder co-search graph, and purpose clusters and hub keywords were derived from search volume.
clusterLandscape.hubTable.title: Hub Keyword Summary
clusterLandscape.hubTable.note: The representative (hub) keyword of each purpose cluster. A hub is the central keyword with the most co-search connections, so it stands for that cluster.
clusterLandscape.flow.title: Search Flow (From → To)
clusterLandscape.flow.note: The main routes along which interest moves, starting from a hub keyword. They show how exploration carries from one cluster to another.
report.purpose.title: Background & Purpose
